summary: Iteration 15 (Multi-Company + HSN + RCM) tested end-to-end. 15/15 backend tests pass (companies CRUD, default flip, delete-last guard, trip/invoice scoping via X-Company-Id, HSN per invoice with PDF text verification via pypdf, RCM vs Normal totals, per-company invoice prefixes VBK/26-27/0001 & BKA/26-27/0001, legacy /api/company scoped to active, backfill of legacy trip company_id, auto GST state matching, dashboard scoped by company). Frontend UI verified: sidebar company-switcher-select lists both companies and switching persists localStorage.active_company_id (page also reloaded to reflect BKA as active); Settings companies-section renders per-row Make Default/Delete buttons and a Default chip; /invoices/new exposes invoice-hsn dropdown with values 996791 & 996511 and mutex gst-rcm-btn/gst-normal-btn toggles; api.js interceptor sends X-Company-Id header (verified by manually setting active_company_id then fetching /api/trips with header — scoped result returned).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2558 lines — should be split into modules (companies, trips, invoices, reports, auth).
Legacy _next_invoice_number (line 859) is unused after multi-company migration; consider removing to avoid confusion.
In list_companies, _backfill_company_id runs on every request — cheap but slightly wasteful; consider gating behind a per-user flag.

set_default_company: two-step update (set target true, then set others false) is not atomic — if the second update fails, multiple defaults could exist. Consider using a transaction or resetting first then setting.
_active_company_id silently ignores an X-Company-Id header that doesn't belong to the user (falls back to default) — could hide client bugs; a 400/404 might be safer for API consumers.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-seed and clean via module-scoped fixture. For UI test, created a second company 'BKA Logistics' (prefix BKA, Karnataka) alongside the auto-created 'My Company' default. Test data remains for main-agent verification; can be cleaned via db.{trips,invoices,customers,companies,audit_logs}.deleteMany({user_id:'test-user-bitumen'}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 clean pass. Route order /api/invoices/overdue before /api/invoices/{iid} is intact. Multi-company invoice numbering uses _next_invoice_number_for_company (per-company sequence). PDF byte-search will fail because ReportLab uses FlateDecode — extract text via pypdf as done in test_09/10.
